notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version 0.4.0.

Increased play area outside of the dungeon.

New challenges and half hearts to collect.

More story content.

Bugfixes and general improvements.

Steam Cloud Enabled.

If you tried the demo before and enjoyed it be sure to check out this version. It has a lot of new stuff.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version 0.3.0.

Can now sprint by holding down roll.

Remix several rooms.

Add pushback when enemies are hit.

Remove thrust attack. Rolling canceled into an attack is always better.

Don't play hit stop if enemies are invulnerable.

Lots of bugfixes.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to version 0.2.0.

Improved player responsiveness when moving and increased speed of attacks.

Increase speed of camera tracking to be more responsive.

Add an attack that cancels the forward roll.

These changes make the player much more responsive. If you found combat laggy in previous versions try it again it feels much better.

Remember which enemies were killed in the previous room. Enemies now respawn when you get 2 rooms away.

Synchronize demo code with internal development version.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1.0
notes.content:
The demo build has been updated based on feedback and internal testing.

There is now a control guide that shows what buttons perform what actions.

Initial shader compilation progress is now shown on screen. You can play during this time, but performance will be reduced during compilation.

The camera behaves better near walls and will move upward so you can still see.

The character will hold their shield more to the side and have more motion when you go to block.

Enemies move a little slower than the original demo version.
